summary.text: Kris R. Vollrath is the Republican candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 156, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democratic incumbent Christopher Pielli.
A West Chester resident and business owner, he previously ran for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Kris R. Vollrath was born in Bryn Mawr, Pennsylvania, and earned a bachelor's degree from West Chester University of Pennsylvania in 1988 after attending Penn State.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he has been a West Chester resident since 1970 and graduated from East High School in 1983.

He said he spent nearly 25 years in information technology positions, including executive roles, before starting Vollrath Renovations, a West Chester design/build company specializing in kitchen, bath and basement projects.
Ballotpedia lists him as affiliated with NARI and AVIXA (InfoComm).
Vollrath won the Republican primary for District 156 on April 23, 2024, and lost the November 2024 general election to Pielli, 58.6% to 41.3%.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.
In his 2024 survey, he said that if elected he would support House Bill 1840, which he described as intended to eliminate sanctuary cities in Pennsylvania.
